children: Instacart Marketplace expands convenient access to Dollar General's everyday low prices through same-day delivery
SAN FRANCISCO, Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Instacart (Nasdaq: CART), a leading grocery technology company, and Dollar General Corporation (

), America's general store, today announced a new partnership to offer same-day delivery of Dollar General's everyday essentials through the Instacart App and website. The partnership will launch with a pilot at approximately 7,000 Dollar General and pOpshelf stores in six states in the coming weeks with plans to expand to approximately 20,000 stores across 48 states this fall.

Through the partnership, customers will be able to shop Dollar General's broad assortment of affordable products on Instacart, including food and snacks, household essentials, and health and beauty products - with delivery in as fast as one hour.

"Dollar General's vast footprint and longstanding commitment to affordability make them an important addition to the Instacart Marketplace," said Ryan Hamburger, Chief Commercial Officer at Instacart. "As we expand this partnership to approximately 20,000 Dollar General and pOpshelf stores, we'll help provide customers in communities across the country with even greater access to affordable food and everyday essentials, with the convenience of same-day delivery."

"At Dollar General, our mission is Serving Others, and we continually look for new ways to provide customers with the value and convenience they count on," said Tony Rogers, senior vice president and chief marketing officer at Dollar General. "Our partnership with Instacart provides another convenient way for customers to access affordable food, household essentials and other products they need while saving them valuable time."
Dollar General will join more than 2,200 national and local retail banners on the Instacart Marketplace.

Instacart is a leading grocery technology company that partners with more than 2,200 retail banners – representing nearly 100,000 stores – to transform how people shop for the groceries they need from the retailers they trust, while creating flexible earning opportunities for shoppers. Through the Instacart Marketplace, Instacart Enterprise platform, and Instacart Ads ecosystem, the company powers ecommerce, fulfillment, in-store technology, AI offerings, and advertising for partners.
